arcs.title: The Autumn Creature Survey
arcs.summary: Day 1: The Gorge has filed its first formal autumn creature survey. A creature — unidentified, described by the trail warden as 'fox-adjacent but aware of itself' — has been observed at dawn on the ridgeline above the hollows for three consecutive mornings. It watches the fog. It does not descend. The Magical Creature Survey Office has opened a preliminary file. Day 2 should develop the creature's behaviour or a second sighting by a different witness, perhaps with a detail that makes it more specific and charming.
